primary_destination_popularity_definitio: A test destination is popular_modal when it lies inside a training-only personal R90 support region whose cluster has the maximum outer-training endpoint support for that user. Tied maxima are retained.
prefix_analogue_definition: For each user and observation ratio, 32-point arc-length prefix distance is compared with the training leave-one-out nearest-neighbour distribution. No close train analogue means that the test nearest-neighbour distance exceeds the selected training-only quantile.

bootstrap.design: paired hierarchical user-then-trip bootstrap within stratum
